reason: The agent hit its monthly spend limit ('You've hit your monthly spend limit.' after 'Baked for 2m 22s') and the person then opened the usage-credits dialog, which is drawn with 'Usage credit balance', 'Wait for limit to reset' and 'Resets 1pm (America/Toronto)'. The session is stopped on its allowance and a reset time is on the screen; the allowance rule applies even though the screen is heavily overdrawn.
factsNote: The agent is read off the screen's own chrome (the bypass-permissions bar and the turn summary line are this agent's). The activity state is WaitingForInput because a turn-brief package is built when a turn ends, which is the moment the session goes idle. Machine, repository and mission are not recorded in the package, so they are left empty.
